vedic_reference.note: Rohini is a star in the constellation of Taurus and is ruled by Mars. Rohinish can be considered as the one who is moving towards Mars.

historical_references.reference: Rohini is an asterism in Indian astronomy, representing the cowherd boy Rohini, who was the charioteer and attendant to the god Krishna.

Rohini is also the name of a lunar mansion in Hindu astronomy, located in the constellation of Taurus. This lunar mansion is considered auspicious and is associated with goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity.
